BundleInfo.name: ChimeraX-VinaGridBox
BundleInfo.Author: Ayan Bhowmik
BundleInfo.Synopsis: Visualize and edit AutoDock Vina search spaces, derive selection boxes, and inspect bounds.
BundleInfo.Description:
ChimeraX Vina Grid Box (VinaGridBox) defines, visualizes and checks AutoDock Vina search spaces directly on molecular structures. It exposes Vina's center_x/center_y/center_z and size_x/size_y/size_z values in a responsive GUI, shows exact Cartesian bounds, copies Vina-ready configuration values, and checks whether selected atoms are inside the box. Boxes can be generated from the current selection using recommended minimum/maximum bounds plus padding or a ligand-centroid method for comparison with Vina's ligand-derived convention. The optional rounded map-extent outline illustrates grid-spacing discretization without changing exported size values.
The GUI supports numerical editing, undo/redo, mouse-based box movement and face resizing, color selection, and a toggle between normal scene-depth occlusion and drawing the box on top of the scene. VinaGridBox does not run docking or prepare PDBQT files. It uses ChimeraX's built-in AutoDock PDBQT reader and sets that native format as the preferred default for .pdbqt files; it does not register a separate PDBQT reader or provide a separate PDBQT-opening action.
This release is distributed under LGPL-2.1-only because the mouse interaction implementation includes adapted third-party code. See LICENSE.txt and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Author and maintainer: Ayan Bhowmik (ayan.bhowmik.bd@gmail.com). Coding and debugging were carried out with assistance from ChatGPT (OpenAI).
